name: 数织
tagline: 根据数字提示涂满格子，揭开隐藏的图画。
description: 在浏览器中免费玩数织：依照行列数字提示涂格子，揭开图画，5 × 5 到 15 × 15，都能靠逻辑解出。
about: A nonogram is a picture puzzle solved by logic. Each row and each column has a clue: the lengths of the runs of filled cells in that line, in order. A clue of 3 1 means a run of three filled cells, then at least one empty cell, then a single filled cell. Work out which cells are filled, and a picture appears.

Every puzzle here is generated for you and checked so that it has exactly one answer, reachable by logic alone, one line at a time. You never need to guess. The sizes go from a quick 5 × 5 to a long 15 × 15.
Mark cells you know are empty with a cross; crosses are only notes and don't count. Play alone to beat your best time, or race friends online on the same puzzle.
howToPlay: Choose a size. The clock starts with the puzzle.
Read the clues: the numbers beside each row and above each column are the runs of filled cells in that line, in order, separated by at least one empty cell.
Fill the cells that must be filled. Switch to Cross to mark cells that must be empty.
A clue dims when its line matches it.
The puzzle is solved when the filled cells match the picture exactly.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a cell to fill it, or switch to Cross first; tap again to clear.
Mouse: click to fill, or switch to Cross.
Keyboard: move with the arrow keys, press Enter or Space to fill, and X to cross.
Pause or start a new puzzle from the bar above the game.
tips: Start with big runs: in a line of 10, a run of 7 must cover the middle four cells wherever it sits.
A clue of 0 means the whole line is empty: cross it out.
When the runs plus their gaps fill a line exactly, the whole line is known.
Cross cells you've ruled out. Crosses at the edges often fix where a run can start.
Switch between rows and columns: each new cell gives the crossing line more to work with.

faq.question: Is Nonogram free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Do I ever have to guess?
faq.answer: No. Every puzzle is checked to be solvable one line at a time, by logic alone.

faq.question: Do crosses count?
faq.answer: No. Crosses are notes for cells you know are empty. Only the filled cells have to match the picture.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same puzzle at the same moment, and the first to finish the picture wins.
